Bella: Ciao, I'm Bella from Italy. I'm making caprese skewers. Anyone can make these. You just need mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves. Just put them on skewers, and they'll become healthy snacks. Caprese skewers are low in calories, so I often eat them as a light snack.

Mina: Hi, I'm Mina from Korea, and I'm baking tofu chips. Unlike other chips, my tofu chips are healthy. Why? I don't fry my chips but bake them. I don't use any flour, either. I use only tofu. Eat the tofu chips with honey or garlic powder. They'll taste good.

questions.explanation:
표와 지문을 비교하면:
- ⓐ (from Brazil) - 일치
- ⓑ (mozzarella cheese) - 일치
- ⓒ (tofu only, no flour) - 일치
- ⓓ (healthy and delicious) - 일치
- ⓔ (high in calories) - 불일치 (low in calories라고 명시)
- ⓕ (fried, not baked) - 불일치 (baked라고 명시)
따라서 일치하지 않는 것은 2개입니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 (A), (B)와 쓰임이 같은 것을 각각 <보기>에서 골라 올바르게 짝지은 것은?

- Is he (A)writing an email to his teacher?
- He (B)can solve this math problem easily.

<보기>
ⓐ His dream is becoming a doctor.
ⓑ Are they having lunch at the cafeteria?
ⓒ I enjoy playing the piano in my free time.
ⓓ We are not swimming because it is too cold.
ⓔ This can't possibly be true.
ⓕ Can she run faster than him?
ⓖ Can I use your phone for a moment?
ⓗ You can call me anytime you need help.
questions.explanation:
(A) 'Is he writing'은 현재진행형(be + -ing)입니다. 같은 쓰임은:
- ⓑ 'Are they having' (현재진행형)
- ⓓ 'We are not swimming' (현재진행형)

(B) 'can solve'는 조동사 can + 동사원형입니다. 같은 쓰임은:
- ⓕ 'Can she run' (조동사 can + 동사원형)
- ⓗ 'can call' (조동사 can + 동사원형)

따라서 정답은 (A) ⓑ, ⓓ / (B) ⓕ, ⓗ 입니다.

- ⓐ them → three teen chefs (O) 올바름
- ⓑ them → mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves (O) 올바름
- ⓒ them → calories (X) 잘못됨. 'them'은 'caprese skewers'를 지칭
- ⓓ them → Mina's tofu chips (O) 올바름
- ⓔ They → tofu chips with honey or garlic powder (X) 잘못됨. 'They'는 'tofu chips'를 지칭하며, 'with honey or garlic powder'는 먹는 방식을 설명할 뿐
